_comment: Curated regulatory & event calendar for the Account-targeting + Regulatory-timing lens. 'type': deadline (hard date) | window (buying window opens) | event (market-structure event). 'date' ISO. 'products' link the obligation to Printec offerings. Refreshed 2026-06-25 from Agent 3 (regulation) 2026-06-24 + Agent 2/4/6 findings; every item traces to a cited primary source (full https:// URL so the dashboard renders it clickable). Banks typically commit budget 6-12 months BEFORE a deadline, so the dashboard counts down to each date.

items.title: Brink's & NCR Atleos shareholder votes on the $6.6bn merger
items.forces: Both companies' special meetings vote on the merger (close targeted ~Q1 2027). Printec's key ATM partner is set to become part of a CIT conglomerate (Brink's also part-owns KAL, runs Brink's Hellas) that can sell hardware + logistics + managed services end-to-end. Scenario planning required.

items.title: Bulgaria: free lev->euro exchange at banks ends
items.forces: Conversion workload drops sharply after this date; banks rationalise the temporary cash capacity built for the changeover -> fleet optimization, recycler recalibration, decommissioning, managed services.

items.title: Slovakia: subsidised-terminal scheme application window closes (eKasa mandate live 01/05/2026)
items.forces: Act 384/2025 requires every eKasa merchant to allow a cashless payment >EUR 1 (POS or QR); the 12-month fee-free terminal subsidy for new card-accepting SMEs closes now -> POS/SoftPOS + TMS demand via banks/PSPs.

items.title: EPC Verification of Payee (VoP) rulebook v2.0 public consultation closes
items.forces: Shapes the next VoP matching/response-code rules (v2.0 publication ~end Nov 2026); banks plan name-matching/anti-fraud tooling roadmaps.

items.title: MiCA absolute backstop + TFR Travel Rule (zero threshold) in force
items.forces: No crypto-asset services to EU clients without CASP authorisation (RO/CY/BG grandfathering ends 24/06; GR ended 30/12/2025). Banks taking the notification route become the compliant on-ramp and need AML/KYC + monitoring + HSM.

items.title: Croatia Post (HP) annual POS-device maintenance / data-centre tender activity
items.forces: POS/data-centre maintenance contracts; needs local partner/registration to bid. (Earlier 26.2.83 POS-maintenance line status unverified this run.)

items.title: Bank of Albania banknote-packaging materials tender closes (UNVERIFIED)
items.forces: ~EUR175k cash-handling supply. Status/value UNVERIFIED (bankofalbania.org returns 403 to all tools) — operator must confirm before acting.

items.title: EU AML: AMLA submits the bulk of its RTS rulebook to the Commission
items.forces: Final harmonised CDD/EDD/UBO/transaction-monitoring detail submitted -> kicks off the H2-2026 buying wave for KYC/onboarding, transaction-monitoring and resilience tooling; AMLR applies 10/07/2027.

items.title: NLB vs RBI Addiko takeover — acceptance deadline (SEE bank consolidation)
items.forces: Competing bids (NLB EUR37 vs RBI EUR26.50) for Addiko's 5-market SEE estate; winner triggers a multi-year ATM/card/channel integration programme (x-core, OptiCash, Siron, TMS). Freezes standalone Addiko spend meanwhile.

items.title: Western Balkans TIPS-clone instant-payments platform go-live (~July 2026)
items.forces: Banca d'Italia-built ISO 20022 instant switch goes live across five footprint countries (Albania may slip to autumn) -> bank-side payment hubs, 24/7 ops, sanctions screening, later VoP + ATM/POS acceptance.

items.title: EPC VoP rulebook v1.1 becomes effective
items.forces: Banks must update VoP/matching engines to v1.1 -> name-matching/anti-fraud tooling and payment-hub integration.

items.title: SWIFT CBPR+: unstructured postal addresses removed (Town+Country mandatory)
items.forces: Every footprint bank with cross-border SWIFT traffic must remediate counterparty master-data to structured addresses or payments are NAKed; MT101->pain.001; Case Management Phase 1. Data-quality + message-transformation project.

items.title: EUDI Wallet availability deadline (>=1 wallet per EU member state)
items.forces: Member states must make a wallet available; banks become relying parties/verifiers for wallet-based remote eKYC and SCA. <1/3 of states ready as of Apr-2026 (RO/BG/HR lagging).

items.title: Hungary: Act XVIII Phase 2 'ATM in every settlement >500 people' deadline
items.forces: ~631 net-new mandated rural ATMs (Phase 1's ~1,039 done) into low-traffic sites -> low-cost deployment, recyclers, remote monitoring, outsourced operation. Procurement is private — pursue the 9 obligated banks directly.

items.title: Albania: POS acceptance mandate for all remaining businesses
items.forces: 2026 fiscal package mandates a POS terminal for all taxpayers (accommodation/transport/public institutions were due 30/05/2026) with cash limits cut -> large POS/TMS/acquiring rollout; Mastercard ~4,750 free terminals accelerate volume.

items.title: Bulgaria: Instant Payments Regulation compliance (VoP + equal-charges)
items.forces: BG (euro since 01/01/2026) must implement IPR provisions one year after adoption. Rails already on TIPS via BORICA, so the residual work is Verification of Payee + equal-charges + instant-fraud screening -> budgets commit H2-2026.

items.title: Instant Payments: RECEIVE obligation + equal charges (CZ, HU, RO)
items.forces: Non-euro EU members must be able to RECEIVE instant euro credit transfers -> payments-hub + ISO 20022 + fraud screening spend committing H2-2026.

items.title: NCR Atleos / Brink's merger expected close (~Q1 2027)
items.forces: Printec's key partner becomes part of a CIT conglomerate selling hardware+logistics+managed-services end-to-end. Strategic scenario planning required (continuity / direct competition / rival-OEM courtship). UK CMA review pending.

items.title: Instant Payments: SEND obligation + VoP (CZ, HU, RO, from EUR accounts)
items.forces: Must be able to SEND instant euro credit transfers from EUR accounts + provide Verification of Payee -> completes the instant-rails + name-matching build-out.

items.title: EU AMLR applies (single AML rulebook; EUR 10k cash cap; CASPs in scope)
items.forces: Harmonised CDD/EDD/UBO across all footprint markets; onboarding/monitoring stacks must be compliant; wallet/eID remote-KYC formally accepted; cash thresholds touch recycler reporting workflows.

items.title: AMLA direct supervision begins + SSM TLPT first 3-yr cycle deadline (17/01/2028)
items.forces: ~40 cross-border groups (Erste/RBI/OTP candidates) under direct AMLA supervision; TLPT threat-led testing drives remediation spend on telemetry, monitoring, HSM/PCI.

items.title: Digital euro: potential first issuance (target, contingent on 2026 legislation)
items.forces: 12-month PSP pilot H2 2027-2028; potential issuance 2029. Distribution via banks/PSPs -> ATM/POS acceptance-device + DESP back-end certification, wallet/onboarding, HSM/key management. Low-confidence, long-fuse.

items.title: European Accessibility Act: service-provider transition ENDS
items.forces: Pre-2025 ATMs/terminals only to end of economic life (max 20 yrs from commissioning); every new install since 28/06/2025 must be born-accessible. ESAmeA complaint (GR, 18/02/2026) raising near-term pressure. Replace-vs-retrofit cycle 2027-2030.
